name: murphy
description: Parent repo for the Murphy RAG system: Docker Compose serving stack + backend/frontend/data submodules.
//: Two profiles. `ingest` = the 3 databases + TEI, which is what data/ needs to run `kedro run`. `serve` = those plus backend + frontend. The databases carry no profile, so they start under either — declared once, shared by both. WARNING: `docker compose down` without a --profile flag does NOT stop profiled services; it reports success and leaves them running. That is why down/restart/logs/status name both profiles explicitly.

scripts.down: npm run compose -- --profile ingest --profile serve down
scripts.restart: npm run compose -- --profile ingest --profile serve restart
scripts.logs: npm run compose -- --profile ingest --profile serve logs -f
scripts.status: npm run compose -- --profile ingest --profile serve ps --format "table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}"
